patent.title: 电池包、车辆和储能装置
patent.family_note: Part of a same-day BYD long-cell / CTP pack filing wave; secondary media more often cite sibling CN110165116B when discussing Blade Battery, not this exact grant.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources establish BYD inventorship and filing but do not reconstruct internal R&D origin of this exact application versus the broader Blade Battery program.

technology.problem: Conventional EV battery packs waste pack volume and add weight through module frames plus pack cross/longitudinal beams, limiting energy density and increasing assembly complexity.
technology.mechanism: The granted patent claims a battery pack with a cell array and support member where at least one hard-shell cell has a first size of 600–2500 mm and is supported via a support region on the housing against the support member, enabling cells themselves to provide structural stiffness and reduce or eliminate beams.
technology.comparison_baseline: Module-based packs with end/side plates plus pack beams; patent text contrasts ~40% volume utilization versus claimed higher utilization.

value_carriers.name: 刀片电池 / Blade Battery（候选价值载体，映射未确认）

gaps.description: No public regulated disclosure or official BYD document reviewed names ZL201910544929.3 / CN110165118B as implemented in Blade Battery, Han EV, or another specific carrier. Secondary sources map sibling CN110165116B instead.
